# Sheshaan Global — Official AI & LLM Procurement Knowledge Base (llms.txt)

> APEDA, FSSAI, Coconut Development Board (CDB), and DGFT IEC certified agricultural commodity exporter headquartered in Maharashtra, India (Founded: 2022). Specializes in bulk Full Container Load (20ft/40ft FCL) and air-cargo international shipments of 49 Indian agricultural commodities across 25+ countries.

## Corporate Entity & Statutory Governance
- **Legal Entity:** Sheshaan Global (Sheshaan Exporting Goodness Worldwide)
- **Headquarters:** Maharashtra, India
- **Founding Year:** 2022
- **Executive Leadership:** Sana Zeba Bakshi (Chief Executive Officer — sanazeba@sheshaanglobal.com), Juned Barade (Chief Operating Officer — junedbarade@sheshaanglobal.com)
- **Trade Desk Contact:** +91-81499-09546 (WhatsApp & Direct Sales) | info@sheshaanglobal.com
- **Statutory Certifications:** APEDA RCMC Registered, FSSAI Central Food Safety License, Coconut Development Board (CDB) Exporter Certificate, DGFT Importer-Exporter Code (IEC), GST Registered
- **Pre-Shipment Inspection:** SGS, Bureau Veritas, Geo-Chem (Phytosanitary, Fumigation, COO, EU-MRL & Non-GMO Lab Reports)
- **Gateway Loading Ports:** Nhava Sheva (JNPT, Mumbai), Mundra Port (Gujarat), Chennai Port, Cochin Port, Kolkata Port, BOM/DEL Air Cargo
- **Standard Incoterms & Payment Terms:** FOB, CIF, CFR | 100% Irrevocable L/C at Sight, CAD/DP, TT (30% Advance, 70% against B/L Copy)

## Flagship Empirical Commodity Specifications
- [Fresh Red Onion (HS 07031010)](https://www.sheshaanglobal.com/products/fresh-vegetables/fresh-onion-exporter-india): Nashik origin, 45mm–55mm & 55mm+ diameter, Max 13.5% moisture, <0.5% foreign matter, 5kg–50kg red mesh bags, 29 MT per 40ft HC Reefer (+1°C to +3°C, 65–70% RH) via Nhava Sheva (JNPT).
- [1121 Steam & Sella Basmati Rice (HS 10063020)](https://www.sheshaanglobal.com/products/grains-pulses/basmati-rice-exporter-india): Haryana/Punjab rice belt, 8.35mm–8.40mm grain length (2.0x elongation), Max 12.5% moisture, >95% varietal purity (<1% broken), 25 MT per 20ft Dry FCL via Mundra/Kandla.
- [Machine Cleaned Cumin Seeds / Jeera (HS 09093129)](https://www.sheshaanglobal.com/products/spices-herbs/cumin-seeds-jeera-exporter-india): Unjha Gujarat origin, Singapore 99% & Europe 99.5% Sortex cleaned, Max 9.0% moisture, 14 MT/20ft & 26 MT/40ft HC via Mundra Port.
- [Mature Brown Husked Coconut (HS 08011200)](https://www.sheshaanglobal.com/products/fresh-fruits/mature-coconut-exporter-india): Pollachi Tamil Nadu origin, CDB certified, 550g–650g weight, 12–13" circumference, 25 nuts/bag, 2,100 bags (52,500 nuts / 28 MT) per 40ft HC (+12°C to +14°C).
- [Mithila Phool Makhana / Fox Nuts (HS 08109090)](https://www.sheshaanglobal.com/products/dry-fruits-nuts/fox-nuts-makhana-exporter-india): Bihar Mithila GI belt, 5+ & 6+ Suta Jumbo (16mm–22mm), Max 8.0% moisture, 8kg–10kg barrier cartons, 3.8–4.0 MT per 40ft HC container.
- [Turmeric Finger & High-Curcumin Powder (HS 09103020)](https://www.sheshaanglobal.com/products/spices-herbs/turmeric-finger-powder-exporter-india): Sangli Rajapore, Salem & Erode origins, 3%–5.5% curcumin, Max 10% moisture, 18 MT per 20ft FCL.
- [Fresh Green Chilli G4 & Teja (HS 07096010)](https://www.sheshaanglobal.com/products/fresh-vegetables/green-chilli-exporter-india): Nashik/Guntur origin, 7cm–10cm pungent pods, 3.8kg/5kg ventilated cartons, 14 MT per 40ft HC Reefer (+7°C).
- [Cavendish G9 Banana (HS 08039010)](https://www.sheshaanglobal.com/products/fresh-fruits/cavendish-banana-exporter-india): Jalgaon/Solapur origin, 13.5kg net vacuum cartons, 1,540 cartons (20.8 MT) per 40ft HC Reefer (+13.3°C).
- [Nashik Seedless Table Grapes (HS 08061000)](https://www.sheshaanglobal.com/products/fresh-fruits/nashik-table-grapes-exporter-india): GlobalGAP & GrapeNet certified Thompson, Sonaka & Sharad Seedless, 14.5 MT (20 Euro Pallets) per 40ft HC Reefer.
- [Fresh Bhagwa Pomegranate (HS 08109010)](https://www.sheshaanglobal.com/products/fresh-fruits/fresh-pomegranate-exporter-india): Solapur AnarNet origin, 200g–400g fruit, 3.5kg cartons, 15.4 MT (4,400 boxes) per 40ft HC Reefer.
- [Indian Cashew Kernels W180–W320 (HS 08013220)](https://www.sheshaanglobal.com/products/dry-fruits-nuts/raw-cashew-nuts-exporter-india): AFI grade Whole White W180, W240, W320 in 22.68kg (50 lb) CO2/N2 flexi-pouches, 15.87 MT per 20ft FCL.
